entries.comment: Max stack size multiplier for every item that stacks (max stack > 1).
Largest stack size (the game stores it as 16 bits: at most 65535).

Server: send this server's content changes (items and recipes: data packs and mods' code changes) to Kiln
clients when they join and whenever they change.
Server: send the [Synced] entries of server and common configs to Kiln clients.
Client: apply a server's content changes while connected (taken off again on leave).
Client: use a server's [Synced] config values while connected (local values come back on leave).

Client: while connected, also put back what this game changed on its own (local mods and data packs) where
the server has the game's original value, so the registries match the server's exactly.
Largest content document (uncompressed JSON, KiB) a server sends or a client accepts.

mods.name: Big Stacks
mods.description: Raises the max stack size of every stackable item (x4, at most 9999; kiln/config/bigstacks.json). Kiln clients get the stack sizes from the server (docs/kiln/sync.md); vanilla clients may show stacks above the normal size oddly.

mods.name: Claims
mods.description: Protected areas: only their owners may build, dig, open containers, loot or craft inside. Sample for kiln.gameplay.

mods.name: New Items (sample)
mods.description: Sample for kiln.content's new items and recipes (Forge's DeferredRegister): a Frost Edge sword and Frost Shards with two hand-crafting recipes, from code, plus a Frost Lantern from a data pack. Install it on the server and on every player's game (side both): ids come from fixed GUIDs, so both sides agree, and the client shows the names, icons and recipes.
